name: Subway Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast on Artisan Italian White
whyItWorks: Sliced lean oven-roasted turkey breast served on soft Artisan Italian white bread (refined white flour, low in fiber and seedless). Ordered plain or with light olive oil and salt, it is dairy-free, citrus-free, and remarkably soothing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: "6-inch Turkey on Artisan Italian white bread. Not toasted. No cheese, no onions, no jalapeños, no peppers. Add light olive oil and a dash of oregano or salt."
